words.enDefinition: The division of the skeleton that includes the bones of the head and neck, vertebral column, ribs, and sternum.

examples.en: The axial skeleton is shaded blue in the front view of the anatomy model.
examples.zh: 解剖模型的正视图中，「中轴骨骼」涂成蓝色。

examples.en: We identified the ribs as part of the axial skeleton on the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂挂图上指出肋骨属于「中轴骨骼」。

words.enDefinition: The division of the skeleton consisting of the limb bones and the shoulder and pelvic girdles.

examples.en: The appendicular skeleton includes the arm bones marked in green on the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 「附肢骨骼」包括课堂示意图上用绿色标出的上肢骨。

examples.en: We classified the shoulder girdle under the appendicular skeleton before labelling the individual bones.
examples.zh: 我们先把肩带归入「附肢骨骼」，再标注各块骨。

words.enDefinition: The central bony column formed by the vertebrae, sacrum, and coccyx, with discs between many adjacent vertebrae.

examples.en: The vertebral column curves in several places in the side view of the skeleton.
examples.zh: 骨骼侧视图上的「脊柱」有几处弯曲。

examples.en: We marked the three main movable regions of the vertebral column on the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂挂图上标出「脊柱」三个主要可动区段。

words.enDefinition: One of the individual bones that make up the vertebral column.

examples.en: The tutor turned one vertebra around to show its shape from the side.
examples.zh: 老师转动一块「椎骨」，展示它从侧面看是什么形状。

examples.en: We matched each vertebra from the model set to its region on the spine chart.
examples.zh: 我们把模型组中的各块「椎骨」与脊柱图中的相应区段配对。

words.enDefinition: One of the seven vertebrae that form the neck region of the vertebral column.

examples.en: The cervical vertebra is placed above the rib-bearing vertebrae on the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型上，「颈椎骨」放置在与肋骨相连的椎骨上方。

examples.en: We compared the shape of one cervical vertebra with a bone from the lumbar region.
examples.zh: 我们把一块「颈椎骨」的形状与一块腰椎骨作了比较。

words.enDefinition: One of the twelve vertebrae in the chest region, which articulate with the ribs.

examples.en: Each thoracic vertebra on the chart is shown beside its corresponding pair of ribs.
examples.zh: 图上每块「胸椎骨」都画在与它相应的一对肋骨旁。

examples.en: We located a thoracic vertebra by matching its rib connection to the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把肋骨连接处与课堂图对应起来，定位一块「胸椎骨」。

words.enDefinition: One of the five vertebrae in the lower back above the sacrum.

examples.en: The lumbar vertebra has a broad body in the specimen shown during the anatomy lesson.
examples.zh: 解剖课展示的标本里，「腰椎骨」有宽大的椎体。

examples.en: We fitted the lumbar vertebra above the sacrum in the teaching model of the spine.
examples.zh: 我们在脊柱教学模型里，把「腰椎骨」放在骶骨上方。

words.enDefinition: The triangular bone at the base of the vertebral column, formed from fused sacral vertebrae.

examples.en: The sacrum appears between the two hip bones in the rear view of the pelvis model.
examples.zh: 骨盆模型的后视图上，「骶骨」位于左右髋骨之间。

examples.en: We identified the sacrum before putting the lower spine and the pelvis together on the model.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「骶骨」，再在模型上把脊柱下部与骨盆拼合起来。

words.enDefinition: The small bone at the lower end of the vertebral column, below the sacrum.

examples.en: The coccyx is the small lower part of the spine marked on the classroom model.
examples.zh: 「尾骨」是课堂模型上标出的脊柱末端小骨。

examples.en: We located the coccyx by following the outline down from the sacrum on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图上从骶骨沿轮廓向下，找到「尾骨」。

words.enDefinition: The bony and cartilaginous framework of the chest formed by the thoracic vertebrae, ribs, costal cartilages, and sternum.

examples.en: The thoracic cage is shown from the side so both the ribs and sternum are visible.
examples.zh: 「胸廓」采用侧面视图，因此肋骨和胸骨都能看见。

examples.en: The class labelled three structures that form the thoracic cage in the skeleton diagram.
examples.zh: 全班在骨骼图上标出构成「胸廓」的三处结构。

words.enDefinition: The flat bone at the front of the chest that joins many ribs through costal cartilage.

examples.en: The sternum lies at the centre of the chest in the front view of the model.
examples.zh: 模型正视图中，「胸骨」位于胸部中央。

examples.en: We located the sternum first and then followed the neighbouring costal cartilages on the chart.
examples.zh: 我们先在挂图上找出「胸骨」，再沿着相邻的肋软骨看过去。

words.enDefinition: The hyaline cartilage at the anterior end of a rib that helps connect it with the chest framework.

examples.en: The costal cartilage is coloured differently from the bony part of the rib on the diagram.
examples.zh: 示意图中，「肋软骨」与肋骨的骨性部分颜色不同。

examples.en: We identified the costal cartilage at the front end of the marked rib in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在标记肋骨的前端指出了「肋软骨」。

words.enDefinition: The long, curved bone that connects the sternum to the scapula in the shoulder girdle.

examples.en: The clavicle runs across the front of the upper chest in the classroom skeleton model.
examples.zh: 在课堂骨骼模型上，「锁骨」横跨上胸前方。

examples.en: We labelled the clavicle from the sternum to the outer part of the shoulder model.
examples.zh: 我们从胸骨到肩部模型的外侧标注「锁骨」。

words.enDefinition: The flat triangular bone at the back of the shoulder that articulates with the humerus and clavicle.

examples.en: The scapula is triangular in the posterior view of the classroom shoulder model.
examples.zh: 在课堂肩部模型的后视图中，「肩胛骨」呈三角形。

examples.en: We located the scapula before fitting the upper arm bone to the shoulder model.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「肩胛骨」，再将上臂骨与肩部模型接合。

words.enDefinition: The bone of the upper arm that extends from the shoulder to the elbow.

examples.en: The humerus joins the shoulder model at the rounded upper end shown in the diagram.
examples.zh: 示意图上，「肱骨」在圆形的上端与肩部模型接合。

examples.en: We identified the humerus before comparing the two bones that extend from the elbow.
examples.zh: 我们先指出「肱骨」，再比较从肘部延伸的两块骨。

words.enDefinition: The forearm bone lying on the thumb side in the anatomical position.

examples.en: The radius is marked on the thumb side of the forearm in the front view.
examples.zh: 正视图上，「桡骨」标在前臂的拇指侧。

examples.en: We followed the radius toward the wrist while looking at the labelled forearm model.
examples.zh: 我们看着有标签的前臂模型，沿「桡骨」向腕部追踪。

words.enDefinition: The forearm bone lying on the little finger side in the anatomical position.

examples.en: The ulna is marked on the side of the forearm nearest the little finger.
examples.zh: 「尺骨」标在前臂靠小指的一侧。

examples.en: We compared the upper end of the ulna with the other bone on the model.
examples.zh: 我们比较了模型上「尺骨」的上端和另一块骨。

words.enDefinition: One of the small bones that make up the wrist between the forearm and the hand.

examples.en: Each carpal bone sits in one of two rows on the classroom wrist model.
examples.zh: 在课堂腕部模型上，每块「腕骨」位于两排骨中的一排。

examples.en: We matched a carpal bone to the outline shown on the drawing of the wrist.
examples.zh: 我们将一块「腕骨」与腕部图上所示的轮廓对应起来。

words.enDefinition: One of the five bones of the palm between the wrist bones and the finger bones.

examples.en: The metacarpal extends from the wrist region toward the base of the marked finger.
examples.zh: 「掌骨」从腕部附近延伸到标记手指的根部。

examples.en: We labelled each metacarpal before tracing the fingers on the classroom hand diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先标出各块「掌骨」，再沿课堂手部图上的手指查看。

words.enDefinition: One of the bones in a finger or toe.

examples.en: The phalanx at the tip of the finger is marked with an arrow in class.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，箭头指着手指尖端的「指骨」。

examples.en: We located one phalanx in the big toe and checked where it meets the next bone.
examples.zh: 我们找出大脚趾中的一块「趾骨」，再看它与相邻骨在哪里相接。

words.enDefinition: One of the paired bones of the pelvis, formed by the fused ilium, ischium, and pubis.

examples.en: The hip bone on each side has a socket for the thigh bone in the model.
examples.zh: 模型上，每侧「髋骨」都有一个容纳大腿骨的关节窝。

examples.en: We traced the outline of one hip bone in the front view of the anatomical chart.
examples.zh: 我们沿解剖图的正视图描出一侧「髋骨」的轮廓。

words.enDefinition: The broad upper portion of the hip bone.

examples.en: The ilium forms the broad upper part of the hip bone on our pelvis model.
examples.zh: 在骨盆模型上，「髂骨」构成髋骨宽阔的上部。

examples.en: We traced the curved upper edge of the ilium in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示意图上沿着「髂骨」弯曲的上缘查看。

words.enDefinition: The lower back portion of the hip bone.

examples.en: The ischium forms the lower rear portion of the hip bone in the side view.
examples.zh: 侧视图上，「坐骨」构成髋骨的后下部。

examples.en: We found the ischium by comparing the labelled front and side views in the anatomy guide.
examples.zh: 我们比较解剖指南中带标注的正视图与侧视图，找出「坐骨」。

words.enDefinition: The anterior portion of the hip bone that meets the corresponding part on the other side.

examples.en: The pubis is marked at the front of each hip bone on the pelvis model.
examples.zh: 骨盆模型将「耻骨」标在各侧髋骨的前部。

examples.en: We labelled the pubis before comparing the three parts of the hip bone in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先标出「耻骨」，再比较髋骨的三个组成部分。

words.enDefinition: The thigh bone extending from the hip to the knee.

examples.en: The femur extends from the hip socket to the knee in the classroom skeleton model.
examples.zh: 课堂骨骼模型中，「股骨」从髋关节窝延伸到膝部。

examples.en: We turned the femur model to compare its upper and lower ends during the lesson.
examples.zh: 讲解时，我们转动「股骨」模型，比较它的上下端。

words.enDefinition: The bone at the front of the knee, embedded in the quadriceps tendon.

examples.en: The patella is shown at the front of the knee in the side view.
examples.zh: 侧视图上，「髌骨」画在膝关节前面。

examples.en: We watched the patella move on the articulated model as the knee was gently bent.
examples.zh: 轻轻屈曲关节模型的膝部时，我们观察「髌骨」如何移动。

words.enDefinition: The larger of the two lower leg bones, on the medial side.

examples.en: The tibia is the larger bone on the inner side of the model lower leg.
examples.zh: 模型小腿内侧较大的那块骨是「胫骨」。

examples.en: We labelled the tibia first and then traced its lower end to the ankle.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「胫骨」，再沿它的下端查看到踝部。

words.enDefinition: The slender bone running along the lateral side of the lower leg beside the tibia.

examples.en: The fibula runs alongside the larger bone on the outer side of the model leg.
examples.zh: 模型腿外侧的「腓骨」与较大的胫骨并排。

examples.en: We compared the lower end of the fibula with the adjacent ankle bones on the chart.
examples.zh: 我们在图上将「腓骨」的下端与相邻的踝部骨作比较。

words.enDefinition: One of the seven bones in the rear and middle part of the foot.

examples.en: The tarsal bone in the model lies behind the long bones of the forefoot.
examples.zh: 模型中的「跗骨」位于前足较长的骨后方。

examples.en: We chose one tarsal bone and located its position on the side view in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们选取一块「跗骨」，在侧视图上找到它的位置。

words.enDefinition: One of the five long bones between the tarsal bones and the toe bones.

examples.en: The first metatarsal extends toward the big toe in the classroom diagram of the foot.
examples.zh: 课堂足部图中，第一「跖骨」朝大脚趾方向延伸。

examples.en: We traced a metatarsal from its base to the rounded head on the teaching model.
examples.zh: 我们在教学模型上沿一块「跖骨」从骨底看到圆形的跖骨头。

words.enDefinition: The large tarsal bone forming the bony part of the heel.

examples.en: The calcaneus forms the heel in the side view of the classroom foot model.
examples.zh: 课堂足部模型的侧视图上，「跟骨」构成足跟。

examples.en: We labelled the calcaneus before comparing the shapes of two neighbouring bones in the foot.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「跟骨」，再比较足部两块相邻骨的形状。

words.enDefinition: The tarsal bone between the lower leg bones and the heel bone that helps form the ankle joint.

examples.en: The talus sits above the heel bone and below the tibia in the ankle model.
examples.zh: 踝部模型上，「距骨」位于跟骨上方、胫骨下方。

examples.en: We identified the talus before tracing the joint surface on the supplied ankle diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先指出「距骨」，再沿给定踝部图查看关节面。

words.enDefinition: A bone whose length exceeds its width and that typically has a shaft and two ends.

examples.en: The femur is a long bone with a distinct shaft between its two ends.
examples.zh: 股骨属于「长骨」，其两端之间有明显的骨干。

examples.en: We labelled the main regions of a long bone on the classroom cutaway model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂剖面模型上标出一块「长骨」的主要区域。

words.enDefinition: A bone whose length, width, and thickness are roughly similar, such as many wrist bones.

examples.en: The tutor used a wrist bone to illustrate the shape of a typical short bone.
examples.zh: 老师用一块腕骨说明典型「短骨」的形状。

examples.en: We compared a short bone with a long bone using the two classroom models.
examples.zh: 我们用两个课堂模型比较「短骨」与长骨。

words.enDefinition: A relatively thin, often curved bone such as the sternum or scapula.

examples.en: The model sternum is classified as a flat bone because of its broad thin shape.
examples.zh: 模型胸骨因形状宽而薄，被归为「扁骨」。

examples.en: We compared the thickness of a flat bone with the shaft of the long bone.
examples.zh: 我们比较了一块「扁骨」的厚度和长骨骨干的厚度。

words.enDefinition: A bone with a complex shape that does not fit the long, short, or flat categories.

examples.en: A vertebra is an irregular bone with a more complex outline than the simple classroom shapes.
examples.zh: 椎骨是「不规则骨」，轮廓比课堂展示的简单形状复杂。

examples.en: We chose the irregular bone from the models and matched it to a spine drawing.
examples.zh: 我们从模型里选出「不规则骨」，把它与脊柱图对应起来。

words.enDefinition: A bone that develops within a tendon, such as the patella.

examples.en: The patella provides an example of a sesamoid bone in the classroom knee diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂膝部图以髌骨为「籽骨」的例子。

examples.en: We compared the position of a sesamoid bone with the tendon that surrounds it.
examples.zh: 我们观察「籽骨」的位置，并与包裹它的肌腱作比较。

words.enDefinition: A joint where bones are connected by fibrous connective tissue without a joint cavity.

examples.en: The fibrous joint is shown as a narrow connection between the two bones on the diagram.
examples.zh: 图中两块骨之间的窄连接表示「纤维性关节」。

examples.en: We compared a fibrous joint with the joint model that has a fluid-filled space.
examples.zh: 我们把「纤维性关节」与具有液体充填腔隙的关节模型作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A fibrous joint between neighbouring bones of the skull.

examples.en: The cranial suture appears as an irregular line between two bones on the skull model.
examples.zh: 头骨模型上，「颅缝」表现为两块骨之间的一条不规则线。

examples.en: We traced the cranial suture across the top of the labelled teaching model in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们沿带标注教学模型的顶部查看「颅缝」。

words.enDefinition: A fibrous joint where bones are connected by a ligament or an interosseous membrane.

examples.en: The syndesmosis is highlighted where the lower leg bones meet near the ankle in the chart.
examples.zh: 图上在小腿两骨靠近踝部的连接处突出标出了「韧带联合」。

examples.en: We compared a syndesmosis with a skull suture using two diagrams in the anatomy lesson.
examples.zh: 解剖课上，我们用两张图比较「韧带联合」与颅缝。

words.enDefinition: A joint in which neighbouring bones are united by cartilage without a synovial cavity.

examples.en: The cartilaginous joint has a layer of cartilage between the marked bones in the illustration.
examples.zh: 图示的「软骨性关节」在标记的骨之间有一层软骨。

examples.en: We classified the cartilaginous joint by looking at the tissue connecting its bones in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们根据连接两块骨的组织对「软骨性关节」分类。

words.enDefinition: A cartilaginous joint in which hyaline cartilage directly connects the bones.

examples.en: The first rib connection is shown as a synchondrosis in the classroom diagram of the chest.
examples.zh: 课堂胸部图把第一肋与胸骨的连接画成「软骨结合」。

examples.en: We used the tissue label to distinguish a synchondrosis from another kind of cartilaginous joint.
examples.zh: 我们根据组织标签，把「软骨结合」与另一种软骨性关节区分开。

words.enDefinition: A cartilaginous joint in which bones are joined by fibrocartilage.

examples.en: The symphysis between two vertebral bodies includes a disc in the simplified spine drawing.
examples.zh: 简化脊柱图里，两个椎体之间的「纤维软骨联合」含有一个椎间盘。

examples.en: We located the symphysis at the front of the pelvis on the labelled model.
examples.zh: 我们在带标注模型的骨盆前部找出「纤维软骨联合」。

words.enDefinition: A joint whose articulating bones are separated by a fluid-containing cavity enclosed by a capsule.

examples.en: The synovial joint diagram shows the space between the surfaces of the two bones.
examples.zh: 「滑膜关节」示意图显示两块骨的表面之间有一处腔隙。

examples.en: We labelled the main features of a synovial joint on the classroom cutaway model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂剖面模型上标出一个「滑膜关节」的主要结构。

words.enDefinition: The envelope around a synovial joint, with an outer fibrous layer and an inner synovial lining.

examples.en: The joint capsule surrounds the articulated ends of the bones in the classroom sketch.
examples.zh: 课堂草图中的「关节囊」包围两块骨发生关节连接的末端。

examples.en: We labelled the joint capsule before identifying its inner lining on the teaching model.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「关节囊」，再在教学模型上指出它的内衬。

collocations: fibrous layer of the joint capsule

words.enDefinition: A smooth layer of cartilage covering bone surfaces that meet within a joint.

examples.en: The articular cartilage is drawn as a smooth layer on the end of the bone.
examples.zh: 「关节软骨」画成覆盖骨端的一层光滑结构。

examples.en: We traced the articular cartilage along both joint surfaces in the classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图示上沿两个关节面查看「关节软骨」。

collocations: articular cartilage covering a joint surface

words.enDefinition: The layer lining the inner capsule and other noncartilaginous surfaces within a synovial joint.

examples.en: The synovial membrane lines the inner side of the capsule in the classroom cutaway diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂剖面图中，「滑膜」衬在关节囊的内侧。

examples.en: We distinguished the synovial membrane from the cartilage covering each bone in the model.
examples.zh: 我们把「滑膜」与模型中覆盖各块骨表面的软骨区分开。

words.enDefinition: The lubricating fluid found within a synovial joint cavity.

examples.en: The synovial fluid is represented by blue shading between the cartilage surfaces on the diagram.
examples.zh: 图中软骨表面之间的蓝色阴影表示「滑液」。

examples.en: We discussed how synovial fluid helps the two joint surfaces move smoothly in the model.
examples.zh: 我们讨论「滑液」如何帮助模型中的两个关节面平顺移动。

words.enDefinition: The enclosed space between the articulating surfaces of a synovial joint.

examples.en: The joint cavity lies between the cartilage-covered bone ends on the cutaway knee model.
examples.zh: 膝部剖面模型上，「关节腔」位于覆盖软骨的两个骨端之间。

examples.en: We pointed to the joint cavity before naming the structures around it in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先指出「关节腔」，再说出周围结构的名称。

words.enDefinition: A band of dense connective tissue that connects bones or other structures and helps stabilize a joint.

examples.en: The ligament connects the two bones across the side of the classroom knee model.
examples.zh: 课堂膝部模型上，「韧带」在关节侧面连接两块骨。

examples.en: We coloured the ligament differently from the nearby muscle on the anatomy worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在解剖练习图上用不同颜色区分「韧带」与附近的肌肉。

words.enDefinition: A wedge-shaped fibrocartilage structure that helps distribute load between the joint surfaces of the knee.

examples.en: The meniscus rests between the thigh and shin bones in the labelled knee model.
examples.zh: 带标注的膝部模型上，「半月板」位于股骨和胫骨之间。

examples.en: We compared the shape of one meniscus with the other in the classroom top view.
examples.zh: 我们比较了课堂俯视图中两个「半月板」各自的形状。

words.enDefinition: A small fluid-filled sac that reduces friction between nearby moving structures.

examples.en: The bursa sits between the moving structures shown in the classroom shoulder cutaway diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂肩部剖面图把「滑囊」画在两个可相对移动的结构之间。

examples.en: We located a bursa by matching its label to the picture on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们用练习纸上的图片核对标签，找到一处「滑囊」。

words.enDefinition: A synovial joint with relatively flat surfaces that mainly permit small gliding movements.

examples.en: The plane joint allows small sliding movements between the two flat surfaces in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型中的「平面关节」允许两个平坦表面之间发生小幅滑动。

examples.en: We identified a plane joint between the labelled wrist bones shown on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图的标记腕骨之间找出一处「平面关节」。

words.enDefinition: A synovial joint that mainly permits flexion and extension about one axis.

examples.en: The hinge joint permits the model elbow to bend and straighten in one main plane.
examples.zh: 「铰链关节」使肘部模型可在一个主要平面内屈曲和伸展。

examples.en: We compared the hinge joint with the model that moves freely in several directions.
examples.zh: 我们把「铰链关节」与可向多个方向活动的关节模型作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A synovial joint allowing one bone to rotate around a single axis relative to another.

examples.en: The pivot joint allows the turn shown by the curved arrow on the forearm model.
examples.zh: 「车轴关节」允许前臂模型上的曲箭头所示转动。

examples.en: We located the pivot joint near the upper ends of the two forearm bones.
examples.zh: 我们在两块前臂骨上端附近找出了「车轴关节」。

words.enDefinition: A synovial joint with an oval convex surface fitting a corresponding depression and permitting movement about two axes.

examples.en: The condyloid joint on the classroom wrist model can move about two main axes.
examples.zh: 课堂腕部模型上的「椭圆关节」可以绕两个主要轴活动。

examples.en: We matched the oval joint surface to the condyloid joint drawing on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把椭圆形关节面与练习纸上的「椭圆关节」图对应起来。

words.enDefinition: A synovial joint in which each surface curves inward in one direction and outward in another.

examples.en: The saddle joint is shown where the thumb meets the wrist on our teaching model.
examples.zh: 教学模型把「鞍状关节」画在拇指与腕部相接的部位。

examples.en: We looked at both curved surfaces of the saddle joint in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们观察课堂示意图中「鞍状关节」的两个曲面。

words.enDefinition: A synovial joint in which a rounded bone head fits a cup-shaped depression and moves about several axes.

examples.en: The ball-and-socket joint lets the thigh bone model move in several directions at the hip.
examples.zh: 「球窝关节」让股骨模型可以在髋部向多个方向活动。

examples.en: We identified the rounded head and cup of the ball-and-socket joint in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型上找出「球窝关节」的圆形骨端和杯状关节窝。

words.enDefinition: A bending movement that generally decreases the angle between two body segments at a joint.

examples.en: The elbow model demonstrates flexion as the forearm moves closer to the upper arm.
examples.zh: 前臂靠近上臂时，肘部模型示范了「屈曲」。

examples.en: We drew an arrow for flexion on the side view of the knee model.
examples.zh: 我们在膝部模型的侧视图上用箭头标出「屈曲」。

words.enDefinition: A movement that generally straightens a joint or increases the angle between the linked segments.

examples.en: The joint extension arrow points toward the position where the model elbow straightens in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，「关节伸展」箭头指向模型肘部伸直的位置。

examples.en: We distinguished joint extension from flexion in the side views of the teaching model.
examples.zh: 我们在教学模型的侧视图中把「关节伸展」与屈曲区分开。

words.enDefinition: Movement away from the body's midline, or away from the reference digit in the hand or foot.

examples.en: The arm model shows abduction as it moves out to the side of the torso.
examples.zh: 上肢模型向躯干侧方移动时，示范的是「外展」。

examples.en: We marked abduction with an outward arrow on the front view of the skeleton.
examples.zh: 我们在骨骼正视图上用向外的箭头标出「外展」。

words.enDefinition: Movement toward the body's midline, or toward the reference digit in the hand or foot.

examples.en: The arm model shows adduction as it moves from the side toward the torso.
examples.zh: 上肢模型从侧面靠近躯干时，示范的是「内收」。

examples.en: We drew an inward arrow for adduction on the worksheet's front view of the body.
examples.zh: 我们在练习纸的人体正视图上用向内的箭头标出「内收」。

words.enDefinition: A sequence of joint movements in which the far end of a limb traces a circle or similar loop.

examples.en: The model arm traces a circle during circumduction as the shoulder remains in place.
examples.zh: 模型上肢做「环转」时，远端画出一圈，而肩部保持原位。

examples.en: We used the animated skeleton to distinguish circumduction from rotation around a single axis.
examples.zh: 我们用动画骨骼把「环转」与绕单一轴的旋转区分开。

words.enDefinition: Rotation of a limb around its long axis that turns its anterior surface toward the midline.

examples.en: Medial rotation turns the front surface of the model thigh inward in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 在课堂示意图里，「内旋」使模型大腿的前表面向内转。

examples.en: We labelled medial rotation with a curved arrow around the long axis of the thigh.
examples.zh: 我们沿大腿长轴画弧线箭头，标出「内旋」。

words.enDefinition: Rotation of a limb around its long axis that turns its anterior surface away from the midline.

examples.en: Lateral rotation turns the front of the model thigh outward in the classroom demonstration.
examples.zh: 课堂演示中，「外旋」使模型大腿前表面朝外转。

examples.en: We compared lateral rotation with the arrow showing the opposite direction on the model.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「外旋」与模型上显示相反方向的箭头。

words.enDefinition: Forearm rotation that turns the palm toward the rear from anatomical position, or downward when the forearm is held horizontally in front.

examples.en: The forearm model shows pronation as its palm turns downward with the forearm held horizontally.
examples.zh: 在前臂水平摆放的模型上，手掌向下翻转，展示了「旋前」。

examples.en: We watched the forearm bones change position during pronation in the classroom animation.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂动画中观察前臂骨在「旋前」时如何改变相对位置。

words.enDefinition: Forearm rotation that returns the palm toward the forward-facing anatomical position, or upward when the forearm is held horizontally in front.

examples.en: The forearm model shows supination as its palm turns upward with the forearm held horizontally.
examples.zh: 在前臂水平摆放的模型上，手掌向上翻转，展示了「旋后」。

examples.en: We showed supination on the teaching model and compared the positions of its forearm bones.
examples.zh: 我们在教学模型上示范「旋后」，并比较它的两块前臂骨的位置。

words.enDefinition: Movement at the ankle that brings the top of the foot toward the front of the lower leg.

examples.en: The class model shows dorsiflexion as the top of the foot moves toward the shin.
examples.zh: 当足背靠近胫前时，课堂模型示范的是「背屈」。

examples.en: We labelled dorsiflexion on the side view of the ankle with a curved arrow.
examples.zh: 我们在踝部侧视图上用弧线箭头标出「背屈」。

words.enDefinition: Movement at the ankle that points the foot downward away from the front of the lower leg.

examples.en: The foot model shows plantar flexion as the toes point downward in the side view.
examples.zh: 足部模型在侧视图中脚趾向下指时，展示的是「跖屈」。

examples.en: We marked plantar flexion with the opposite arrow to dorsiflexion in the classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图示中用与背屈相反的箭头标出「跖屈」。

words.enDefinition: Movement that turns the sole of the foot toward the midline of the body.

examples.en: The ankle model shows foot inversion when the sole turns toward the other foot.
examples.zh: 踝部模型的足底转向另一只脚时，展示的是「足内翻」。

examples.en: We drew a curved arrow to represent foot inversion in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图上画一支弧线箭头来表示「足内翻」。

words.enDefinition: Movement that turns the sole of the foot away from the midline of the body.

examples.en: The ankle model shows foot eversion when the sole turns away from the other foot.
examples.zh: 踝部模型的足底朝远离另一只脚的方向转时，展示的是「足外翻」。

examples.en: We used a second arrow for foot eversion on the picture of the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型图上用第二支箭头表示「足外翻」。

words.enDefinition: Movement that brings the pad of the thumb across the palm toward the fingertips.

examples.en: Thumb opposition brings the pad of the model thumb toward the pad of another digit.
examples.zh: 「拇指对掌」使模型拇指的指腹朝另一指的指腹靠拢。

examples.en: We labelled thumb opposition on the hand model after comparing it with simple thumb flexion.
examples.zh: 我们先比较该动作与单纯拇指屈曲，再在手部模型上标出「拇指对掌」。

words.enDefinition: A band or sheet of dense connective tissue that typically transmits muscle force to bone.

examples.en: The tendon joins the lower end of the muscle to the bone on the model.
examples.zh: 模型里，「肌腱」把肌肉下端连到骨上。

examples.en: We coloured the tendon differently from the muscle fibres on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习图上用不同颜色区分「肌腱」与肌纤维。

words.enDefinition: A broad, flat tendon connecting a muscle to a bone or to another structure.

examples.en: The aponeurosis appears as a broad sheet at the end of the muscle in the labelled anatomy diagram.
examples.zh: 带标注的解剖图上，「腱膜」表现为肌肉末端的一片宽阔薄层。

examples.en: We compared an aponeurosis with the narrower tendon on the neighbouring tissue diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把「腱膜」与相邻组织图中较窄的肌腱作了比较。

words.enDefinition: The attachment conventionally described as the more fixed or proximal end of a muscle.

examples.en: The muscle origin is marked near the shoulder on the diagram of the example arm.
examples.zh: 示例上肢图把「肌肉起点」标在肩部附近。

examples.en: We labelled the muscle origin before following the muscle toward its other attachment.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「肌肉起点」，再沿肌肉查看到另一处附着点。

words.enDefinition: The attachment conventionally described as the more movable or distal end of a muscle.

examples.en: The muscle insertion is marked where the example tendon attaches to the forearm bone.
examples.zh: 「肌肉止点」标在示例肌腱与前臂骨相连的部位。

examples.en: We labelled the muscle insertion on the same page as the more fixed attachment.
examples.zh: 我们把「肌肉止点」与相对固定的附着点标在同一页上。

words.enDefinition: The thick, fleshy portion of a muscle containing most of its contractile fibres.

examples.en: The muscle belly is wider than the tendon in this side view of the model.
examples.zh: 模型侧视图上，「肌腹」比肌腱宽。

examples.en: We labelled the muscle belly between the two pale tendon regions on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中两个颜色较浅的肌腱区之间标出「肌腹」。

words.enDefinition: A muscle that produces or contributes directly to a particular movement.

examples.en: The agonist muscle shortens in the simple elbow flexion animation used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂的简化肘部屈曲动画中，「主动肌」缩短。

examples.en: We identified the agonist muscle after the exercise specified which movement to study.
examples.zh: 练习明确了要研究的动作后，我们指出了「主动肌」。

words.enDefinition: A muscle whose action opposes the movement produced by another muscle at a joint.

examples.en: The antagonist muscle acts in the opposite direction from the prime mover in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中，「拮抗肌」的作用方向与主要主动肌相反。

examples.en: We identified the antagonist muscle after the example movement changed from flexion to extension.
examples.zh: 示例动作由屈曲变为伸展后，我们指出了「拮抗肌」。

words.enDefinition: A muscle that assists the main mover by adding force or limiting unwanted movement.

examples.en: The synergist muscle contributes to elbow bending in the animation shown during the lesson.
examples.zh: 课上展示的动画里，「协同肌」帮助屈曲肘部。

examples.en: We located the synergist muscle on the diagram after identifying the main mover in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先确定主要主动肌，再在图中找出「协同肌」。

words.enDefinition: The four shoulder muscles and their tendons that help stabilise the head of the humerus in the socket.

examples.en: The rotator cuff is highlighted around the shoulder joint in the supplied classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 给定课堂示意图在肩关节周围突出标出「肩袖」。

examples.en: We labelled the four muscles of the rotator cuff on the model of the shoulder.
examples.zh: 我们在肩部模型上标出组成「肩袖」的四块肌肉。

words.enDefinition: The rotator cuff muscle lying above the spine of the scapula and helping abduct the arm.

examples.en: The supraspinatus lies above the scapular spine in the posterior view of the model.
examples.zh: 模型后视图上，「冈上肌」位于肩胛冈上方。

examples.en: We marked supraspinatus on the sheet that lists muscles involved in lifting the arm sideways.
examples.zh: 我们在列出参与侧举手臂的肌肉练习纸上标出「冈上肌」。

words.enDefinition: The rotator cuff muscle lying below the spine of the scapula and helping rotate the arm laterally.

examples.en: The infraspinatus fills much of the area below the scapular spine on the teaching model.
examples.zh: 教学模型上，「冈下肌」占据了肩胛冈下方的大部分区域。

examples.en: We traced the infraspinatus toward its attachment near the upper arm in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中沿「冈下肌」追踪到它靠近上臂的附着处。

words.enDefinition: A rotator cuff muscle along the lateral scapula that helps rotate the upper arm laterally.

examples.en: The teres minor lies below the infraspinatus in the rear view of the shoulder chart.
examples.zh: 肩部挂图的后视图上，「小圆肌」位于冈下肌下方。

examples.en: We matched teres minor to the smaller muscle shown along the scapula's lateral edge.
examples.zh: 我们把「小圆肌」与沿肩胛骨外侧缘所画的较小肌肉对应起来。

words.enDefinition: The rotator cuff muscle on the front surface of the scapula that helps rotate the upper arm medially.

examples.en: The subscapularis is visible on the front surface of the detached scapula model shown in class.
examples.zh: 课堂展示的单独肩胛骨模型上，「肩胛下肌」位于前表面。

examples.en: We labelled subscapularis as the cuff muscle on the rib-facing side of the scapula.
examples.zh: 我们标明「肩胛下肌」是肩胛骨朝向肋骨一侧的肩袖肌。

words.enDefinition: The triangular muscle covering the shoulder that helps move the upper arm, including lifting it sideways.

examples.en: The deltoid muscle covers the rounded outer part of the shoulder on the model.
examples.zh: 模型上，「三角肌」覆盖肩部外侧圆隆的部分。

examples.en: We marked the deltoid muscle before comparing the muscles shown deeper around the joint.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「三角肌」，再比较图上关节周围更深处的肌肉。

words.enDefinition: The large superficial chest muscle that helps draw the upper arm toward the body and rotate it inward.

examples.en: The pectoralis major forms the large superficial muscle on the front of the chest model.
examples.zh: 胸部模型前方一大块浅层肌肉是「胸大肌」。

examples.en: We traced pectoralis major toward the arm on the labelled chart in our anatomy lesson.
examples.zh: 解剖课上，我们在有标注的挂图上沿「胸大肌」向手臂方向查看。

words.enDefinition: A broad muscle of the back that helps extend, adduct, and medially rotate the upper arm.

examples.en: The latissimus dorsi spans a broad area of the lower back on the labelled model.
examples.zh: 带标注的模型中，「背阔肌」覆盖下背部的一大片区域。

examples.en: We matched latissimus dorsi to its label before tracing where it attaches to the upper arm.
examples.zh: 我们将「背阔肌」与标签对应，再找它附着在上臂的部位。

words.enDefinition: A broad muscle of the neck and upper back that moves and stabilises the scapula.

examples.en: The trapezius muscle covers part of the neck and upper back on the teaching model.
examples.zh: 教学模型上，「斜方肌」覆盖部分颈部和上背部。

examples.en: We labelled the trapezius muscle before comparing the arrows showing different movements of the scapula.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「斜方肌」，再比较表示肩胛骨不同动作的箭头。

collocations: upper fibres of the trapezius muscle

words.enDefinition: A muscle running from the upper ribs to the scapula that helps move it forward around the chest wall.

examples.en: The serratus anterior is shown along the ribs in the side view of the torso model.
examples.zh: 躯干模型的侧视图上，「前锯肌」沿肋骨排列。

examples.en: We located serratus anterior before following its line toward the inner edge of the scapula.
examples.zh: 我们先指出「前锯肌」，再沿着它查看至肩胛骨的内侧缘。

words.enDefinition: A two-headed muscle at the front of the upper arm that helps flex the elbow and supinate the forearm.

examples.en: The biceps brachii is shown at the front of the upper arm in the diagram.
examples.zh: 示意图把「肱二头肌」画在上臂前侧。

examples.en: We labelled biceps brachii before following the model of elbow bending and palm rotation.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「肱二头肌」，再看示范屈肘和前臂旋转的模型。

words.enDefinition: A three-headed muscle at the back of the upper arm that extends the elbow.

examples.en: The triceps brachii lies behind the upper arm bone in the classroom side view.
examples.zh: 课堂侧视图上，「肱三头肌」位于上臂骨后方。

examples.en: We identified triceps brachii while the articulated model showed the elbow straightening slowly.
examples.zh: 可活动模型缓慢伸直肘部时，我们找出了「肱三头肌」。

words.enDefinition: A muscle beneath the biceps brachii that flexes the elbow.

examples.en: The brachialis is marked beneath the biceps in the cutaway view of the upper arm.
examples.zh: 上臂剖面图把「肱肌」标在肱二头肌的深面。

examples.en: We compared the location of brachialis with the more superficial muscle in the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型上比较「肱肌」与一块较浅层的肌肉的位置。

words.enDefinition: A paired muscle of the front abdominal wall that helps flex the trunk.

examples.en: The rectus abdominis runs vertically beside the midline in the front view of the model.
examples.zh: 模型正视图中，「腹直肌」在正中线两侧竖直走行。

examples.en: We identified rectus abdominis on the chart before checking the illustrated trunk movement.
examples.zh: 我们先在挂图上找出「腹直肌」，再观察图示躯干动作。

words.enDefinition: A superficial muscle of the side of the abdominal wall that helps turn and bend the trunk.

examples.en: The external oblique muscle lies along the side of the abdomen in the model.
examples.zh: 模型里，「腹外斜肌」位于腹部侧方。

examples.en: We compared the fibre direction of the external oblique muscle with the vertical muscle nearby.
examples.zh: 我们比较「腹外斜肌」的肌纤维走向与附近竖直肌肉的走向。

collocations: action of the external oblique muscle

words.enDefinition: A group of muscles along the vertebral column that help extend and laterally bend the spine.

examples.en: The erector spinae is marked on both sides of the spine in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图在脊柱两侧标出「竖脊肌」。

examples.en: We traced the erector spinae upward along the back on the labelled teaching model.
examples.zh: 我们在带标注的教学模型上，沿背部向上查看「竖脊肌」。

words.enDefinition: The large superficial buttock muscle that helps extend and externally rotate the hip.

examples.en: The gluteus maximus forms the broad superficial layer over the buttock in the posterior model.
examples.zh: 模型后视图中，臀部面积较大的浅层肌肉是「臀大肌」。

examples.en: We identified gluteus maximus before reviewing which muscles contribute to hip extension in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先找出「臀大肌」，再回顾哪些肌肉参与髋部伸展。

words.enDefinition: A muscle on the outer side of the hip that helps abduct the thigh and stabilise the pelvis.

examples.en: The gluteus medius is highlighted on the outer side of the hip in the illustration.
examples.zh: 图上髋部外侧突出的标记表示「臀中肌」。

examples.en: We compared gluteus medius with the larger superficial muscle on the posterior model in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在后方视图模型中比较「臀中肌」与一块更大的浅层肌肉。

words.enDefinition: A group formed by the iliacus and psoas major that helps flex the hip.

examples.en: The iliopsoas is shown passing toward the front of the hip joint in the diagram.
examples.zh: 示意图显示「髂腰肌」向髋关节前方走行。

examples.en: We labelled both parts of the iliopsoas before reviewing the model of hip flexion.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「髂腰肌」的两个组成部分，再看屈髋模型。

words.enDefinition: Muscles on the inner thigh that help move the thigh toward the body's midline.

examples.en: The hip adductor muscles are grouped along the inner thigh on the labelled teaching diagram.
examples.zh: 带标注的教学图把「髋内收肌群」画在大腿内侧。

examples.en: We marked the hip adductor muscles before viewing the animation of the thigh moving inward.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「髋内收肌群」，再看大腿向内移动的动画。

collocations: action of the hip adductor muscles

words.enDefinition: A group of four muscles at the front of the thigh that extends the knee.

examples.en: The quadriceps femoris occupies the front of the thigh in the labelled classroom model.
examples.zh: 带标注的课堂模型上，「股四头肌」占据大腿前方。

examples.en: We identified the four parts of quadriceps femoris using the coloured anatomy chart in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用彩色解剖图指出了「股四头肌」的四个组成部分。

words.enDefinition: A group of posterior thigh muscles that flex the knee and mostly also extend the hip.

examples.en: The hamstring muscles are highlighted on the back of the thigh in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图在大腿后侧突出标出「腘绳肌群」。

examples.en: We compared the hamstring muscles with the group on the front of the thigh.
examples.zh: 我们把「腘绳肌群」与大腿前侧的肌群作了比较。

words.enDefinition: The superficial two-headed calf muscle that helps flex the knee and plantar flex the ankle.

examples.en: The gastrocnemius forms most of the visible upper calf on the classroom leg model.
examples.zh: 课堂腿部模型中，「腓肠肌」构成小腿后侧上部的大部分可见轮廓。

examples.en: We labelled both heads of the gastrocnemius in the posterior view of the lower leg.
examples.zh: 我们在小腿后视图上标出「腓肠肌」的两个肌头。

words.enDefinition: A broad calf muscle beneath the gastrocnemius that helps plantar flex the ankle.

examples.en: The soleus lies beneath the more superficial calf muscle in the classroom cutaway view.
examples.zh: 课堂剖面图中，「比目鱼肌」位于较浅层小腿后侧肌肉下方。

examples.en: We identified the soleus by comparing the deep and superficial views of the leg model.
examples.zh: 我们比较腿部模型的深层与浅层视图，找出「比目鱼肌」。

words.enDefinition: A muscle at the front of the lower leg that helps dorsiflex and invert the foot.

examples.en: The tibialis anterior runs along the front of the lower leg in the labelled chart.
examples.zh: 带标注的挂图中，「胫骨前肌」沿小腿前侧走行。

examples.en: We located tibialis anterior before viewing the animation of the foot moving upward at the ankle.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「胫骨前肌」，再观看踝部动作带动足部向上的动画。

words.enDefinition: The tendon connecting major calf muscles, including the gastrocnemius and soleus, to the heel bone.

examples.en: The Achilles tendon reaches the heel bone in the side view of the classroom ankle model.
examples.zh: 课堂踝部模型侧视图上，「跟腱」延伸至跟骨。

examples.en: We traced the Achilles tendon from the calf muscles to the heel on the anatomy chart.
examples.zh: 我们在解剖挂图上沿「跟腱」从小腿后侧肌肉查看到足跟。

words.enDefinition: The shaft or central portion of a typical long bone.

examples.en: The diaphysis is the long middle section in the classroom model of the femur.
examples.zh: 股骨课堂模型中，「骨干」是中间较长的一段。

examples.en: We marked the diaphysis before labelling the two expanded ends of the long bone.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「骨干」，再标注长骨两侧膨大的骨端。

words.enDefinition: An end region of a long bone, typically widened compared with the shaft.

examples.en: The epiphysis is wider than the shaft in the diagram of the upper arm bone.
examples.zh: 上臂骨示意图中，「骨骺」比骨干宽。

examples.en: We compared one epiphysis with the shaft using the labelled longitudinal bone section in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用带标注的骨纵切图比较一侧「骨骺」和骨干。

words.enDefinition: The region of a long bone between the shaft and an epiphysis, next to the growth plate in a growing bone.

examples.en: The metaphysis is labelled between the shaft and the rounded bone end in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂图将「干骺端」标在骨干与圆形骨端之间。

examples.en: We identified the metaphysis on the cutaway drawing before locating the growth plate shown nearby.
examples.zh: 我们先在剖面图上找出「干骺端」，再定位旁边所画的生长板。

words.enDefinition: A layer of hyaline cartilage near the end of a growing long bone where lengthwise growth occurs.

examples.en: The epiphyseal plate is shown as a narrow cartilage band on the growing bone model.
examples.zh: 生长中骨骼的模型把「骺板」画成一条窄的软骨带。

examples.en: We pointed to the epiphyseal plate before comparing the growing and mature models in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先指出「骺板」，再比较生长期模型与成熟模型。

collocations: epiphyseal plate of a long bone

words.enDefinition: A line of bone marking the former location of a growth plate after lengthwise growth ends.

examples.en: The epiphyseal line marks where the growth plate previously lay in the mature teaching model.
examples.zh: 成熟骨教学模型上，「骺线」标示生长板原来的位置。

examples.en: We compared the epiphyseal line with the cartilage band shown on the growing bone diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把「骺线」与生长中骨骼图上的软骨带作了比较。

collocations: epiphyseal line in a mature bone

words.enDefinition: The connective tissue covering the outer surface of bone except at surfaces covered by articular cartilage.

examples.en: The periosteum is drawn as a thin covering along the shaft in the cutaway model.
examples.zh: 剖面模型上，「骨膜」画成沿着骨干的一层薄覆盖物。

examples.en: We placed the periosteum label outside the dense bony layer on the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把「骨膜」标签放在课堂示意图的致密骨层外面。

words.enDefinition: A thin cellular lining on internal bone surfaces, including the marrow cavity and trabecular surfaces.

examples.en: The endosteum lines the inside of the marrow space on the labelled long bone drawing.
examples.zh: 带标注的长骨图上，「骨内膜」衬在骨髓腔内侧。

examples.en: We used the cutaway model to compare the location of the endosteum with the outer covering.
examples.zh: 我们用剖面模型比较「骨内膜」与外层覆盖组织的位置。

words.enDefinition: Dense bone tissue forming the outer layer of bones and much of a long bone shaft.

examples.en: The compact bone forms the dense outer layer in the classroom section of the long bone.
examples.zh: 课堂长骨切面上，「密质骨」构成致密的外层。

examples.en: We compared compact bone with the open network shown farther inside the specimen drawing.
examples.zh: 我们把「密质骨」与标本图中更靠内部的网状结构作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Bone tissue formed by a network of thin struts with marrow spaces between them.

examples.en: The spongy bone has a network pattern in the enlarged picture of the bone end.
examples.zh: 骨端的放大图上，「松质骨」呈网状。

examples.en: We shaded the spongy bone differently from the denser outer layer on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习图上用不同阴影区分「松质骨」与较致密的外层。

words.enDefinition: A small strut or plate of bone forming part of the supporting network in spongy bone.

examples.en: Each trabecula is drawn with a space on either side in the enlarged bone diagram.
examples.zh: 放大的骨示意图上，每根「骨小梁」两侧都画有空隙。

examples.en: We traced one trabecula through the network shown on the classroom image of spongy bone.
examples.zh: 我们沿课堂松质骨图中的网络查看一根「骨小梁」。

words.enDefinition: The central cavity within the shaft of a long bone that contains marrow.

examples.en: The medullary cavity runs through the shaft in the lengthwise view of the model.
examples.zh: 模型的纵切图上，「骨髓腔」贯穿骨干。

examples.en: We labelled the medullary cavity before adding the layers of bone around it on paper.
examples.zh: 我们先在纸上标出「骨髓腔」，再补画它周围的骨层。

collocations: medullary cavity of a long bone

words.enDefinition: Marrow tissue where blood cells are produced.

examples.en: The diagram shows red bone marrow within spaces of spongy bone on the adult model.
examples.zh: 成人模型图把「红骨髓」画在松质骨的空隙中。

examples.en: We distinguished red bone marrow from the surrounding bone tissue in the labelled classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在带标注的课堂示意图上区分「红骨髓」与周围的骨组织。

collocations: blood cell production in red bone marrow

words.enDefinition: Marrow rich in fat cells, commonly found in the shafts of adult long bones.

examples.en: The yellow bone marrow is shown inside the shaft cavity on the adult bone diagram.
examples.zh: 成人骨示意图把「黄骨髓」画在骨干的骨髓腔内。

examples.en: We used the legend to locate yellow bone marrow on the cutaway teaching model.
examples.zh: 我们根据图例，在剖面教学模型上找到「黄骨髓」。

words.enDefinition: A cylindrical structural unit of compact bone with concentric layers arranged around a central canal.

examples.en: The osteon appears as concentric rings around a canal in the classroom cross section.
examples.zh: 课堂横切图上，「骨单位」表现为围绕一条管道的同心环。

examples.en: We labelled the centre of an osteon in the enlarged image of compact bone.
examples.zh: 我们在密质骨放大图上标出一个「骨单位」的中心。

words.enDefinition: A bundle of muscle fibres grouped together by connective tissue within a skeletal muscle.

examples.en: The muscle fascicle is shown as a bundle of fibres in the enlarged teaching diagram.
examples.zh: 放大的教学图把「肌束」画成一束肌纤维。

examples.en: We traced the boundary of one muscle fascicle on the classroom cross section.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂横切图上沿着一处「肌束」的边界查看。

collocations: cross section of a muscle fascicle

words.enDefinition: A single elongated muscle cell, especially a cell of skeletal muscle in this context.

examples.en: The muscle fibre is drawn as one long cell inside the bundle on the diagram.
examples.zh: 图中，「肌纤维」画成肌束内一个细长的细胞。

examples.en: We followed one muscle fibre before looking at the smaller structures inside it in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先沿一条「肌纤维」查看，再观察它内部较小的结构。

words.enDefinition: A contractile strand within a skeletal muscle fibre, made of sarcomeres arranged end to end.

examples.en: The myofibril runs lengthwise within the muscle fibre in the enlarged diagram used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂放大图里，「肌原纤维」沿肌纤维的长度方向延伸。

examples.en: We marked a single myofibril before counting the repeating segments in the model.
examples.zh: 我们先标出一条「肌原纤维」，再数模型里的重复区段。

words.enDefinition: The repeating contractile unit of a myofibril, extending from one Z disc to the next.

examples.en: The sarcomere on the diagram begins and ends at the two dark boundary lines.
examples.zh: 示意图中的「肌节」以两条深色边界线为起点和终点。

examples.en: We compared the length of a sarcomere in the two frames of the classroom animation.
examples.zh: 我们比较了课堂动画的两个画面里一个「肌节」的长度。

words.enDefinition: The structure at a sarcomere boundary to which the thin filaments attach.

examples.en: The Z disc marks one end of the repeating unit in the muscle diagram.
examples.zh: 肌肉示意图上的「Z 盘」标出重复单位的一端。

examples.en: We used a line to mark each Z disc in the enlarged classroom muscle illustration.
examples.zh: 我们用一条线标出课堂肌肉放大图上的各个「Z 盘」。

collocations: sarcomere boundary at the Z disc
thin filaments attached to a Z disc

words.enDefinition: A sarcomere filament composed primarily of actin together with associated regulatory proteins.

examples.en: The thin filament is shown attached to the boundary structure in the classroom sarcomere model.
examples.zh: 课堂肌节模型显示，「细肌丝」附着在边界结构上。

examples.en: We followed the thin filament toward the centre of the repeating segment in the animation.
examples.zh: 我们在动画中沿着「细肌丝」查看到重复区段的中央。

words.enDefinition: A sarcomere filament composed mainly of myosin proteins.

examples.en: The thick filament occupies the middle region of the repeating unit shown in class.
examples.zh: 课堂所示重复单位的中部区域有「粗肌丝」。

examples.en: We used a different colour for the thick filament in our diagram of the sarcomere.
examples.zh: 我们在肌节示意图上用另一种颜色标出「粗肌丝」。

words.enDefinition: The model in which a sarcomere shortens as actin and myosin filaments slide past each other.

examples.en: The sliding filament theory explains why the boundaries of the sarcomere move closer in the animation.
examples.zh: 「肌丝滑行学说」解释了为什么动画里的两个肌节边界会彼此靠近。

examples.en: We drew two frames to illustrate the sliding filament theory on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习纸上画出两个画面，说明「肌丝滑行学说」。

collocations: diagram of the sliding filament theory

words.enDefinition: One lower motor neuron and all the skeletal muscle fibres it innervates.

examples.en: The motor unit diagram connects one motor neuron with several muscle fibres in the teaching example.
examples.zh: 教学示例的「运动单位」图把一个运动神经元与数条肌纤维连在一起。

examples.en: We traced the branching neuron to see which fibres belong to the same motor unit.
examples.zh: 我们沿神经元的分支查看哪些肌纤维属于同一个「运动单位」。

words.enDefinition: The chemical synapse where a motor neuron communicates with a skeletal muscle fibre.

examples.en: The neuromuscular junction is marked where the nerve ending meets the muscle fibre in the schematic.
examples.zh: 示意图在神经末梢与肌纤维相接处标出「神经肌肉接头」。

examples.en: We labelled the neuromuscular junction on a diagram of normal signalling from nerve to muscle.
examples.zh: 我们在神经向肌肉传递正常信号的示意图上标出「神经肌肉接头」。

words.enDefinition: The physiological link between electrical excitation of a muscle fibre and activation of its contractile machinery.

examples.en: The excitation-contraction coupling diagram connects a signal on the muscle cell surface with force inside.
examples.zh: 「兴奋—收缩耦联」示意图把肌细胞表面的信号与细胞内产生的力联系起来。

examples.en: We compared two frames to distinguish excitation-contraction coupling from the subsequent shortening shown in class.
examples.zh: 我们比较两个课堂画面，区分「兴奋—收缩耦联」与之后显示的缩短。

words.enDefinition: An active muscle action generating tension with no appreciable change in overall length.

examples.en: The isometric contraction develops tension while the model keeps the muscle length nearly unchanged.
examples.zh: 「等长收缩」产生张力，同时模型中的肌肉长度基本不变。

examples.en: We identified isometric contraction in the frame where tension rises without visible movement.
examples.zh: 在张力上升却看不到动作的画面中，我们识别出「等长收缩」。

words.enDefinition: An active muscle action in which the muscle shortens while producing tension.

examples.en: The concentric contraction is shown by the shortening muscle in the classroom elbow animation.
examples.zh: 课堂肘部动画用缩短的肌肉显示「向心收缩」。

examples.en: We marked concentric contraction on the part of the timeline where the active muscle shortens.
examples.zh: 我们在时间轴上标出主动发力的肌肉缩短所对应的「向心收缩」区段。

words.enDefinition: An active muscle action in which the muscle lengthens while producing tension.

examples.en: The eccentric contraction occurs as the active model muscle lengthens during the slow downward movement.
examples.zh: 模型中的肌肉在缓慢下放动作中仍有张力并逐渐伸长，属于「离心收缩」。

examples.en: We compared eccentric contraction with active shortening in the two adjacent frames of the animation.
examples.zh: 我们在动画相邻两个画面中，将「离心收缩」与主动缩短作了比较。
